quantize_jit: quantize a float TorchScript model with post training static quantization using a qconfig dict and calibration function
quantize_dynamic_jit: quantize a float TorchScript model with post training dynamic quantization for linear layers
prepare_jit: prepare a TorchScript model for calibration by inserting observers according to a qconfig dict
convert_jit: convert a prepared TorchScript model with observers into a final quantized model
fuse_conv_bn_jit: fuse convolution and batch normalization modules in a TorchScript model for inference optimization
